title: Spec fixtures: synthetic WAV and schema-valid manifest builders, no audio in git
description:
## Intent

Ground work for the M1 specs: fixture helpers the step definitions share.

## Steps

- `crates/apricity-daw/tests/support/`: a synthetic WAV writer (sine plus clicks on the beats, any tempo, a few hundred ms to a few seconds, 48 kHz) and a manifest builder (beats, warp markers, tuning, key) that pass `schema/sample-manifest.schema.json`; validate each generated manifest against the schema in the helper's own test.
- Keep the M0 reference sets under `crates/apricity-daw/tests/fixtures/reference/` loadable by the set checker (they must pass it too).

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw support`; `git ls-files '*.wav'` is empty.

## Release

`chore(<this task's id>): DAW spec fixtures without audio in git`.
